content.headline: Read 90 Pages in 60 Seconds
content.body: NotebookLM and similar tools search your uploaded files first, then answer with the page number as proof. That page number is what lets you check if the answer is correct.
bullets: Upload only public policy documents. Never upload confidential files.
Try four prompts: summary → deadlines with page numbers → FAQ → short briefing note
Page numbers make checking faster. They do not replace the officer's judgment.
